description: UX A1 (olife_a1): rights of entities ('repository' model) and friends on 3 windowed F2F 0.32 clients — alice (owner), bob (becomes a friend), carol (stranger, put on lists) + an admin protocol client (dev) and the real olife-sandboxd. Friends through the UI: bob opens alice's bench (read-only), Settings -> «Друзья» -> alice -> «Добавить»; alice gets a toast, opens the friends page with Shift+` and accepts; carol asks, alice denies; carol's refusals 16/17/15 with the refuse sound. Rights panel through the UI: alice sets move/clone -> friends and run -> list [carol] by clicks (world rules + toasts), bob/carol see the panel read-only with their own rights. Matrix: 9 actions x 4 audiences x 3 actors = 108 cells asserted by RequestReply codes (+ EntityPerms.mine bits); admin bypass (9 cells); negative protocol tests; world <-> supervisor DB friend sync.
